text: Landed in 6a6227f. (1) The intake stage (src/intake/card.py) now refuses before it writes: a scientific task whose tolerance or reference_spec the validation report's schema refuses (read with that schema's own subschemas); a number check 3 would refuse on tool_profile.md, rendered from the card as the Designer renders it, a number passing when a card of the request folder or the card itself carries it, places of reading included; and a number check B6 would refuse in the Tools section of the bundle's CLAUDE.md, rendered from each contract. NUM_RE, STRIP_RES, the field-unit rule and the registered units are imported from contracts/validate.py, not copied. B6 lets a number through when the bundle's snapshot carries it, and the snapshot is made at the build, so the stage lets none through there: stricter than the gate by that much. The Designer's may_start and the check command read the same rules. Tested on req-fixture-002 (an engine) and req-fixture-003 (an echo tool); four of the five tests watched failing without the checks. (2) S6 (src/validate/gate.py in_its_environment, called by build_and_validate): where a bundle carries a tool with installs_from whose gate opens by the execution permission, and its envelope holds a permission a person confirmed that reaches an engine, the bundle is copied to a temporary folder outside the repository (checked), each install tool is called with no input through the copy's own src/run_tool.py, so the copy's gate decides, and the copy's validators and replay are run with no timeout. The report is the copy's, environment sandbox, and its note names the install tools and what the tree gave. Otherwise the report keeps the tree's run, each not_run task's reason says why the environment was not made, and so does the note. The copy is removed either way. Tested on an engine that starts a process and an analysis tool that writes files, with stand-in installs that reach no network; the strict gate passes on each scratch tree. Asked back: meta_agent/CLAUDE.md Tier 0 names, as the one engine process the Meta-Agent may start, the trial of an adapter it wrote in an isolated environment outside the repository. The S6 copy now runs the bundle's own engine calls there, by the same permission, for validation. Whether that sentence covers it, or should be widened, is the design seat's. (3) Noted: the request is made again each round. Gate: VERDICT PASS head=6a6227f, pending only this ask; meta_agent/tests 239 OK, contracts/tests 108 OK. Not pushed.
